properties.name: Link on Demand (Lone Tree)
properties.units: Lone Tree city; Highlands Ranch CDP; Stonegate CDP; Parker town; Castle Rock town
properties.note: Covers Lone Tree, Highlands Ranch, Stonegate, and Castle Rock (added July 31, 2026) fully; Parker coverage is partial ('select areas of Parker', not the whole town) so the Parker polygon here overstates actual coverage — no boundary streets or map are published outside the operator's in-app service-area tool (City.RideWithVia.com/LinkOnDemand). Meridian also served but ambiguous in boundary data (multiple Meridian CDPs exist); mapped coverage uses other resolved places. Service areas are not continuous. Sources: https://www.douglasco.gov/free-link-on-demand-rideshare-now-available-in-stonegate-and-parts-of-parker/ , https://cityoflonetree.com/link-on-demand/

Source: https://townofmountainvillage.com/explore/getting-around/bus-dial-a-ride/

properties.name: RTD FlexRide
properties.units: Brighton city; Broomfield city; Evergreen CDP; Federal Heights city; Golden city; Longmont city; Louisville city; Parker town; Superior town; Thornton city
properties.note: RTD's site (rtd-denver.com/routes-services/other-services/flexride) names 16 zones: Brighton, Broomfield, DTC, Evergreen, Federal Heights, Golden, Green Mountain, Interlocken/Westmoor, Longmont, Louisville, Parker, South Jeffco, Superior, Thornton, Wagon Road, plus Broomfield North per the CSV. 10 of these correspond to a real municipality or CDP and are mapped above, but each FlexRide zone covers only part of that place, not the whole city/CDP, so these polygons overstate actual coverage — treat as approximate/oversized. DTC, Green Mountain, Interlocken/Westmoor, South Jeffco, Wagon Road, and Broomfield North have no matching Census place/CDP or county subdivision (checked the Census TIGER CO place file directly — 'Green Mountain' is not a CDP, only 'Green Mountain Falls', a different town near Colorado Springs) and are omitted entirely — those areas are not represented in the boundary at all. Precise zone shapes are only in RTD's interactive map: https://rtd-denver.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/interactivelegend/index.html?appid=b2d921ef0ad040d28c5ce49527793046&locale=en-us

properties.name: Snowmass Village On-Demand Shuttle (Route 22)
properties.note: Winter service is narrower (on-request stops along Wood Rd up to Wood Run V and Faraway Rd up to the Ridge Condominiums), but the summer schedule (June-Sept) expands Route 22 to all accessible, public, paved roads within the Town of Snowmass Village limits, so the town boundary is the correct outer envelope. https://www.villageshuttle.com/217/Route-22On-Demand

properties.name: Via Mobility - Weld County
properties.note: Not truly countywide: Via's LINK On Call serves a large portion of unincorporated Weld County plus the towns of Fort Lupton, Milliken, Ault, Gilcrest, Hudson, Johnstown, Keenesburg, Kersey, Nunn, and Platteville — it does not cover incorporated Greeley or other larger cities in the county. Weld County polygon used as a containing-unit proxy; actual coverage is smaller/patchier. Operator's own service-area map: bit.ly/WeldCountyMap. Sources: https://viacolorado.org/2023/08/weld-county-announces-new-accessible-transportation-service-for-residents/ , https://coloradocommunitymedia.com/2023/08/09/weld-county-residents-will-have-access-to-transportation-with-via-mobility-services/
